supersedes.reason: V3 established valid sliced and full-suffix arms but exposed a broadcast-only snapshot-budget error. One broadcast source group already fills the 16-trace optimizer batch, while the v3 config admitted two source groups per policy. V4 changes that runtime limit from two to one and runs only the missing broadcast arm.

prior_failed_run.status: terminal broadcast integration failure with no three-arm learning comparison
prior_failed_run.broadcast_exclusion: All v3 broadcast outcomes are excluded from v4 estimation and decision-making. They were used only to diagnose the lifecycle failure. No v3 broadcast reward, gradient, adapter, or evaluation outcome changed v4 seeds, sample counts, thresholds, confidence, model settings, or analysis code.

purpose: Complete the missing trajectory-broadcast control under exact snapshot accounting, then apply the unchanged three-arm Stage C learning and replay-equivalence decision rule.

scope.training_probe_suite: the unchanged eight standard probes; the v8 integration-only needle is excluded

correction.semantics: The value counts complete source environment groups admitted for a policy version, not optimizer batches or serialized traces. In the broadcast environment one source group expands to the full 16-trace optimizer batch.
unchanged: bootstrap seed, confidence, and sample count

strict_snapshot_lifecycle_contract.early_failure_check: After the first two optimizer steps, stop and report a terminal integration failure if their observed policy versions are not zero then one. Do not retry.

required_new_artifacts: all broadcast training and evaluation traces

integration: the v4 broadcast arm completes 75 optimizer steps with exactly 1200 training policy calls
every broadcast training and evaluation trace contains exactly one policy call
every broadcast training and evaluation trace uses policy version step minus one
all broadcast traces complete without errors
broadcast has at least one positive finite gradient step
broadcast saves its final LoRA adapter and no gathered full-model weights
the carried-forward v3 sliced and full-suffix manifests remain byte-identical to their frozen hashes
learning: both carried-forward branch-credit arms meet the unchanged improvement point threshold over v4 broadcast
both paired 90 percent lower confidence bounds exceed zero
the carried-forward sliced and full-suffix arms meet the unchanged replay-equivalence margins
decision_rule.pass: the frozen CPU estimator prerequisite, v8 live integration smoke, carried-forward v3 ReDCO integration evidence, v4 broadcast integration checks, unchanged learning checks, and replay-mode equivalence check all pass
decision_rule.failure: report Gate GC v4 as failed without changing thresholds or retrying the observed v4 broadcast arm

resource_policy.alternative_policy: A different non-spot 2x48GB non-A100/non-H100 resource at no more than 2.00 USD/hour requires a committed hardware-only amendment before provisioning.

scope_limitations.budget_match: 1200 training policy calls per arm; branch evaluations are reported and are not equal because broadcast has no counterfactual branches
scope_limitations.reason: The restricted deterministic verifier deliberately executes both reward paths in-loop, so full and sliced modes have identical model-call topology and do not measure accelerator savings.
scope_limitations.headline_if_passed: minimal synthetic learning and estimator result only, not evidence on real RLM tasks
